throughline.zh: 本週已公布南韓對東協半導體與設備貿易統計，以及台灣手機記憶體成本、資料中心液冷、跨境投資和研發資金資料；產業實績、歷史基期與未來預測保留各自日期。
throughline.en: This week covers Korea–ASEAN semiconductor and equipment trade, Taiwan smartphone memory costs, AI data-center cooling, bilateral investment and research funding, with actuals, historical baselines and forecasts dated separately.

title.zh: 半導體貿易、製程設備與研發資金
title.en: Semiconductor trade, process equipment and R&D

summary.zh: 南韓產業通商部 11 月 1 日發布 10 月半導體出口 564.4 億美元、對東協整體出口 213.3 億美元，並披露半導體設備進口增加；台灣主計總處先前公布第三季設備進口統計，國科會公告 2025 年全國研發經費 1.138 兆元。出口額、研發支出與設備裝機分屬不同口徑。
summary.en: Korea's November 1 trade release detailed US$56.44B of October chip exports and US$21.33B of total ASEAN exports, alongside equipment imports. Taiwan's Q3 equipment-import statistics and its 2025 NT$1.138T R&D survey provide distinct evidence on trade and research, not commissioned capacity.

title.zh: 記憶體價格與手機終端產品

summary.zh: 11 月 1 日台灣三星、vivo 與 OPPO 的受訪內容顯示各品牌面臨不同記憶體成本與售價安排；vivo 表示高階 X 系列在台銷量年增約兩成。TrendForce 的記憶體物料成本占比 34% 取自 8 月的特定 iPhone 研究，須與最新品牌發言分開。
summary.en: November 1 interviews with Samsung, vivo and OPPO Taiwan executives describe differing responses to memory costs, with vivo reporting around 20% growth in its premium X series. TrendForce's 34% BOM memory share is an August estimate for a specific iPhone, not a new November measure.

title.zh: 資料中心電力轉換與液冷部署
title.en: AI data-center power and liquid cooling

summary.zh: 鴻海亞灣超算 10 月 31 日表示近期 AI 資料中心主要採液冷，並討論 NVIDIA 的 800V 高壓直流路線圖。已於 7 月上線的 5MW 叢集為舊有商轉紀錄，本次沒有公布新增已通電負載。
summary.en: On October 31 Foxconn's Visionbay described liquid cooling in recent deployments and discussed NVIDIA's 800V DC roadmap. Its 5MW cluster started in July, with no new energized load announced.

title.zh: 日本對台材料設備投資與綠電條件
title.en: Japanese materials investment and power requirements

summary.zh: 台北市日本工商會 10 月 31 日說明日企對台灣半導體材料、精密設備與再生能源的關注，並提出綠電供應與憑證成本問題。官方統計顯示 2025 年日本對台投資 271 件、8.68 億美元，當日未公布新增核准外資案件。
summary.en: Japan's chamber discussed materials, precision machinery and renewable-power access on October 31. Official records of 271 investments worth US$868M refer to 2025, with no new approved inflow on the briefing date.

title.zh: 晶片設計市場與政府零組件追溯
title.en: Chip design outlook and procurement traceability

summary.zh: 台灣內政部 10 月 31 日公告無人機晶片來源清查，涉及 32 架採購且 30 架尚未交貨；相關司法與契約責任仍待確認。聯發科對 2027 年 AI ASIC 市占約兩成的估計屬未來預測，與政府零組件查核屬不同事件。
summary.en: Taiwan's Interior Ministry reviewed 32 drone procurements, including 30 undelivered units, with sourcing and liability unresolved. MediaTek's estimated 20% AI ASIC share in 2027 is a separate forward-looking chip-design claim.
